purpose: Profile where per-question LongMemEval ingest time goes, to decide the batching lever before committing to the full 500-question run
method: Monkeypatched Embedder.embed_text and StoreMergeMixin.merge_vertices_batched to accumulate wall-clock time, ran 3 representative questions (491/521/503 haystack turns) through the real sync_turn -> drain pipeline, extract_mode=rules_only (the production default)
finding: Embedding dominates (62-76% of wall time, avg 67%), NOT graph writes (consistently ~2%). The real inefficiency: ~8.8 separate embed_text() calls per sync_turn -- one call per extracted entity/mention/concept, not batched. Graph merges are already cheap and fast. Recommendation: batch embedding calls (collect a turn's texts, call embed_texts() once) before committing to the full 500-question run -- this is the real lever to shrink the ~28h projection, not parallelizing providers (already shown to not help, issue #119) and not optimizing graph writes (already fast).
